data.gender_notes: Saketh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: God of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Saketh' meaning 'He who Accompanies'. The name Saketh carries the meaning “God of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Kannada. Parents who choose Saketh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the presence of the god Vishnu, who is believed to be the preserver of the universe. It is a name that instills a sense of security and protection.
data.etymology: Saketh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saketh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Saketh' holds immense cultural significance in Hinduism, as it is associated with the god of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune, Lord Ganesha. In Hindu mythology, Lord Ganesha is known to possess wealth and wisdom, and is often invoked to overcome obstacles and bring about success and good fortune. Those with the name 'Saketh' are believed to carry these qualities within them, and may be seen as natural leaders, problem solvers, and bringers of prosperity and happiness.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name 'Saketh' can be found in its meaning of 'He who Accompanies.' In Hindu scriptures, God is often described as being present with us in every moment of our lives, accompanying us on our spiritual journey. Thus, the name 'Saketh' serves as a reminder of this divinely present companionship and the constant support of the divine in our lives. Embracing this meaning, individuals may find comfort and solace in the knowledge that they are not alone, and that their spiritual journey is supported by the divine presence within them and beyond them.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Saketh, meaning 'benevolent', symbolizes the presence of compassion and kindness in one's life. It is believed that those named Saketh are endowed with wisdom and the ability to protect and care for others. Their spiritual journey is one of selfless love and service to humanity.
